title: Bug 654042: [DocumentReporting] Exporting Word layout themes uses the wrong file extension
summary: Corrected the file extension for exporting Word theme layouts from docx to dotx and added comprehensive test coverage for artifact export functions.
key_points: GetFileExtension function updated to handle Word layout subtypes correctly
Theme layouts now export with correct dotx file extension instead of docx
Added 135+ new tests covering composite and report layout export scenarios
Validates exported theme files load correctly in Microsoft Word
Improves reliability of document reporting export functionality
